(i) the minimal width of ReLU nets needed to uniformly approximate any continuous function of d variables on the unit cube is d+1, (ii) ReLU nets with d+1 hidden layers can uniformly approximate any continuous scalar function of d variables, (iii) ReLU nets of depth d can approximate any continuous scalar convex function of d+1 variables arbitrarily well.
